definitions.explanation: Describes the loud, confused noise of many people talking at once; the din of a crowd.

examples.japanese: {教室|きょうしつ}の{中|なか}はがやがやと{騒|さわ}がしかった。
examples.english: The classroom was noisy with chatter.

examples.japanese: {居酒屋|いざかや}でがやがやと{話|はな}し{声|ごえ}が{聞|き}こえる。
examples.english: I can hear the clamor of voices in the izakaya.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}たちががやがやと{集|あつ}まってきた。
{市場|いちば}はがやがやとした{活気|かっき}に{満|み}ちていた。
examples.english: The market was full of lively commotion.

notes:
SOUND SYMBOLISM: The voiced consonant が conveys a loud, somewhat rough or chaotic sound.

VERB FORMS:
・がやがやする (to be noisy with chatter)
・がやがや{騒|さわ}ぐ (to make a noisy commotion)
・がやがや{言|い}う (to chatter noisily)

NUANCE: Often describes a lively atmosphere rather than unpleasant noise. Can be positive (bustling, lively) or slightly negative (too noisy).

SIMILAR WORDS:
・ざわざわ: Buzzing, rustling (can be anxious undertone)
・わいわい: Boisterously, merrily (more positive)
・ぺちゃぺちゃ: Chattering (often trivial talk)
・ひそひそ: Whispering (opposite - quiet)
